newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on economic uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on economic uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks fell 1.11 percent at Tuesday's close as investors stayed out due to economic fears and dealers said sentiment would remain weak.
"The new government has brought political stability, but the economic outlook remains bad," dealer Shakil Anwar said.

"Investors' main concern is whether Pakistan will be able to meet IMF conditions or not," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "They are shy of investing because the economic outlook is bad. Today individuals squared their positions on clearing day."
The Karachi 100-share index fell 17.63 points to 1,575.98. Losers beat gainers 269 to 38. PTCL fell 0.35 rupees to 29.75 and Kohinoor Power 4.65 to 11.50. - Amir Zia 9221-5685192
